items.title: Vercel and Shopify make agents first-class shoppers
items.summary: Agents already shop on the web, but they often use pages and tools originally built for people and search engines. Building a better shopping experience for agents means treating them as first-class shoppers, with product information they can read directly and tools designed for agents to shop.Today, , our open source  storefront template for , is generally available. Teams can launch storefronts optimized for how people, search engines, and agents interact with them.Vercel ShopNext.jsShopifyVercel Shop is built on . The SDK gives teams access to the store’s product catalog, cart and order management, payments, and checkout to build custom storefronts. Earlier this year,  to work across JavaScript frameworks. Today, the rebuilt SDK is generally available.Shopify’s Hydrogen SDKVercel and Shopify announced plans to rebuild HydrogenVercel Shop makes product pages available as , including price, availability, and options. The same product URL can serve a visual page to people or product information that agents can read without interpreting the page’s layout. The template also includes structured data embedded in pages and sitemaps to help search and answer engines discover and understand the products.machine-readable contentShopify co-developed the  (UCP), which gives agents a standard way to search a store’s catalog, read product details, check availability, build a cart, and get a checkout link. Vercel Shop makes these capabilities discoverable at the merchant’s own domain, so agents can use MCP to search products and build carts without navigating the site.Universal Commerce ProtocolVercel Shop brings the store’s product catalog, cart, and checkout together with a Next.js storefront, product information and shopping tools for agents, and a shopping assistant powered by . The storefront and assistant live in the same codebase, so teams can customize the store’s design and how the assistant helps shoppers.eve guide coding agents through setup, customization, and template updates. Teams can create an experience where shoppers browse product pages or ask the assistant to find products and add them to their cart. Both share the same cart, so shoppers keep what they’ve added as they move between experiences.Skills included in the templateToday, we launched our merch store at  with limited-edition drops. It’s built on Vercel Shop. The store’s shopping agent helps shoppers find products, add them to their cart, and continue to checkout.vercel.storeShopify, Next.js, and Vercel already power storefronts for brands including AG1, Bombas, and PAIGE. When PAIGE , it saw a 22% increase in revenue and a 76% increase in conversion over Black Friday and Cyber Monday, with no downtime.re-architected its ecommerce platformCreate a storefront:Get started with .
